_README: Landmarks that sit more than 12 mm off the measured bone surface on BOTH Visible Human bodies (male ct_vhm/ct_vhm_arm, female ct_vhf). Being off on two independent bodies makes the landmark the likelier culprit than either mesh -- unless the bone is truncated on both scans (humerus distal end). Report only: no coordinate has been changed; the correction is a reviewer's call, made with the audit's per-landmark output and the bone frame stated there.
source: Derived from scripts/audit_landmarks_vs_geometry.py on the meshes in this repository.

rows.landmark: medial epicondyle (common flexor origin; ulnar nerve groove)
